capabilities: Convert notes to EPUB with Obsidian's Markdown renderer
Send notes or folders to the reader over local Wi-Fi
Upload books to the Xteink Lover shelf via OPDS
Sync new and changed notes from chosen folders and a tag
Auto-send new notes appearing in a watched folder
disambiguation: Not a general vault-sync tool; it pushes notes one-way to a specific e-reader as EPUB files.
extras: README warns that CrossPoint has no login or encryption, so Wi-Fi sends use plain HTTP and should stay on trusted networks; notes content stored on Xteink Lover can be avoided by self-hosting the server; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get notes onto an e-reader as EPUB without external tools like pandoc or a desktop app.

relations.evidence: Uploads to your online shelf; the reader downloads it over OPDS
The default folder is Clippings, where Obsidian Web Clipper saves

summary: Sends Obsidian notes to an Xteink X3/X4 e-reader running CrossPoint firmware as EPUB, over local Wi-Fi or via the Xteink Lover shelf.
